description: Use this when the user asks which accounts include a perk or benefit -- a credit card annual fee rebate, a safe deposit box, free drafts or cheques, rewards points, a borrowing rate discount. With benefit set, returns includes / does_not_include / not_recorded across products; without it, every tracked benefit per product. not_recorded is unknown, never 'not included'. A benefit with basis 'bank_default' is the bank's standard terms for all accounts (no product-specific benefit recorded): say so rather than calling it a feature of the plan. An unknown benefit name returns an error listing the benefits BLIA tracks. Ongoing perks only; welcome offers are in list_offers, and fees and waiver rules in get_product_terms.

benefit.description: One benefit, e.g. safe_deposit_box, credit_card_annual_fee_rebate, bank_drafts. Omit for every benefit BLIA tracks.

cohort.description: Customer group the terms apply to. Default "current" (the standard offer). Other groups a product carries (e.g. "senior_60_plus") are listed per product as variants; pass one to get that group's terms. Case and punctuation are ignored.

institution.description: Institution id (bmo, cibc, rbc, scotia, td: the Big 5) or a common or legal name such as BMO, RBC or Scotiabank. Omit for all.

product_class.description: Product class. Only "chequing" is covered today.

province.description: Province: a two-letter code or a name such as Ontario. A benefit priced differently in that province is answered with its price there. Default "ALL".
